title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يلتقي الرئيس المصري محمد مرسي
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Meets the Egyptian President Muhammad Morsi
body_ar: التقى الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء أمس الأربعاء 04 يوليو 2012 بالرئيس المصري الدكتور محمد مرسي بهدف تهنئته بمناسبة انتخابه رئيسا لجمهورية مصر العربية، وإسداء بعض النصائح والتوجيهات. و كانت زيارة الشيخ الددو لرئيس دولة مصر ضمن وفد من الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلين برئاسة الشيخ يوسف القرضاوي، حيث هنأوه بمناسبة انتخابه رئيسًا للجمهورية وحصوله على ثقة الشعب المصري وتمنوا له التوفيق. وقد شارك في اللقاء الأمين العام للاتحاد، والدكتور خالد المذكور، والدكتور عبد اللطيف المحمود، والدكتور محمد الحسن ولد الددو، والدكتور صلاح سلطان أعضاء مجلس الأمناء، والدكتور نصر فريد واصل، رئيس مكتب الاتحاد فى مصر، والدكتور عطية فياض نائب رئيس مكتب الاتحاد فى مصر، والدكتور محمد مختار المهدي عضو مجلس الأمناء. ويزور الشيخ الددو هذه الأيام جمهورية مصر العربية من أجل المشاركة في الملتقى العالمي الثالث لمنظمة "فور شباب"..الذي ينظم هذا العام تحت شعار: "هندسة التغيير.. التكوين والأدوات".
body_en:
Yesterday, Wednesday 4 July 2012, Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, met the Egyptian president Dr Muhammad Morsi, with the aim of congratulating him on the occasion of his election as president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, and of offering some counsel and guidance.

Sheikh al-Dedew's visit to the head of the Egyptian state was as part of a delegation from the International Union of Muslim Scholars headed by Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi; they congratulated him on the occasion of his election as president of the republic and on his gaining the confidence of the Egyptian people, and wished him success.

Taking part in the meeting were the Union's secretary-general; Dr Khalid al-Madhkur, Dr Abd al-Latif al-Mahmud, Dr Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew and Dr Salah Sultan, members of the board of trustees; Dr Nasr Farid Wasil, head of the Union's office in Egypt; Dr Atiyyah Fayyad, deputy head of the Union's office in Egypt; and Dr Muhammad Mukhtar al-Mahdi, member of the board of trustees.

Sheikh al-Dedew is visiting the Arab Republic of Egypt these days in order to take part in the Third International Forum of the "4Shabab" organisation, organised this year under the banner "The Engineering of Change: Formation and Instruments".

flags.arabic: التقى الشيخ ... بالرئيس المصري الدكتور محمد مرسي ... وإسداء بعض النصائح والتوجيهات
options: translate faithfully and refer the publication decision upward
translate and publish as ordinary content
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, style guide section 12. A factual record of a courtesy visit in July 2012 to a head of state who was deposed a year later, whose movement was subsequently proscribed in Egypt and elsewhere, and who died in custody. Several of the individuals named alongside the Sheikh have since faced prosecution or designation in one jurisdiction or another. The record itself is entirely innocuous — congratulations and good wishes — but republished in English in the present it can be read as a political alignment, and the phrase 'offering some counsel and guidance' invites the inference that he advised the president, which the record does not substantiate and whose content it does not give. Nothing has been softened or omitted. The decision on publication, and on whether to date-stamp it prominently, belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.context: the stated purpose of the visit, alongside congratulation
options: and of offering some counsel and guidance
and to give some advice and direction
flags.note: The phrase asserts that advice was given to a head of state and says not a word about its content; naṣīḥah in this register is sincere counsel owed to a ruler, a recognised duty, rather than political instruction. An English reader will supply content the record does not have. The rendering keeps the vagueness of the Arabic rather than resolving it in either direction.

flags.context: the name of the delegation's body
options: read as المسلمين, 'of Muslim Scholars', as the body is properly named
flags.note: Source typo: a dropped mīm in المسلمين. The International Union of Muslim Scholars is rendered by the English name the body itself uses. Preserved in body_ar and flagged.

flags.context: the same event called a مؤتمر in record 799 of this slice
options: render each as the source gives it
flags.note: Record 799, two days earlier, calls this the Third 4Shabab International Conference; here it is the Third International Forum. Both are rendered as served. The pair also fixes the date of the Sheikh's Cairo lecture (3 July) against this meeting (4 July), which is useful, since the CMS dates establish nothing.

translator_notes: A news-desk report of a meeting. It contains no words of the Sheikh's and no religious content.
The CMS timestamp, 5 July 2012, is a bulk-upload date; the body dates the meeting to Wednesday 4 July 2012.

Names of the other participants are transliterated in the forms usual in English-language coverage of the International Union of Muslim Scholars; none is glossed or identified beyond what the source gives.
The source writes في with a dotless yāʾ (فى) twice, an Egyptian-keyboard habit; left as served.
